title: Theory Trace Card: Theory-Driven Socio-Cognitive Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating existing socio-cognitive benchmarks (e.g., moral reasoning, empathy, Theory of Mind) for WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) bias by analyzing their underlying psychological frameworks, and proposing the Theory Trace Card (TTC) to explicitly document these cultural limitations and assumptions.
